_doc: WALLING UP ALIVE (systems/immurement.js). WHO: one of the condemned awaiting your word (systems/executions.js) whose crime is treason, heresy or the shame of the House (crimes with treason / heresy / disgrace), or your own wife or husband (the 'disgraced' spouse: no court needed, no guilt proven). WHERE: a seat you rule with the right of the sword (Executions.seats); walls names the walls by the town's size. THE DEED is unseen: no crowd, no chronicle; the victim simply vanishes (townsfolk die 'vanished', their kin left with no word; a spouse is gone). deed: Traits deeds and karma at once. THE SECRET is kept on player.immurement.secrets; every week the servants may talk (reveal.perWeek, x reveal.perServant for each servant in your household at that seat, x reveal.rite after a priest was asked to lay the ghost, + reveal.wronged for an innocent; reveal.afterDays first): then Atrocities 'immure' brands you (butcher, karma, every realm's regard, lords' memory immured / immured_heard, the town's atrocity mark, the House chronicle, the news), the gossip 'immured', the kin of a townsperson remember a murder, a spouse's kin House a grudge. THE HAUNTING lives on the town (settlement.haunting, saved with the tile; world.immurement.towns lists them): strength starts at haunt.start (x haunt.wronged for the innocent) and halves every haunt.halfLifeYears (120 days a year): generations. While it walks: your household's servants at that seat lose haunt.servantMood x strength of mood a day (player/household.js: below quitBelow for quitDays they leave); guests come less often (x 1 - haunt.arrivalCut x strength) and a stay ends badly with chance haunt.unsettle x strength; the town's happiness falls haunt.happiness x strength a month; on a night you spend there, an apparition (haunt.apparition x strength): your comfort and sleep. LAY IT: a priest's rite (lay.cost into the town's purse, the ghost's strength x lay.keep, lay.cooldown days; the priest asks whose ghost it is) or break open the wall and bury the bones (breakWall.cost to the masons, into the town's purse: the haunting ends, the deed is out). AI: a cruel or suspicious crown (ai.traits) walls up a traitor at its capital now and then (ai.chance a week): a haunting there, the servants' talk later (ai.reveal a week: the news, the crown's stability ai.stability).

deed: The masons lay the last course by lantern light. {name}'s voice goes on behind the stones for a long while, and then it does not.
They lead {name} down to the cellars of {walls} at {town}. The mortar is still wet at dawn. No one speaks of it.
spouse: {name} is gone. If anyone asks, {he} went on pilgrimage. The masons were paid twice their wage, and told to forget.
reveal: The servants of {town} talk: of the bricked-up place in the cellar wall, and of what was heard behind it. Now the whole town knows.
apparition: You wake in the small hours at {town}. Someone is weeping behind the cellar wall, and a cold draught moves the bed-curtains. You do not sleep again.
In the passage at {town} a pale shape stands where the new stones are. When you lift the candle there is nothing there. The servants will not meet your eye at breakfast.
heard: In {town} they say {walls} is haunted: a soul walled up alive by {by}, they whisper, and on still nights the stones weep.
laid: The priest of {town} sprinkles the stones, prays long, and asks you once whose spirit it is. The house is quieter.
broken: The masons break open the wall at {town}. What is behind it goes to the churchyard, at last. The house breathes easier, and the whole town knows.
faded: Whatever walked {walls} at {town} is gone at last. The old servants say they miss it, nearly.
aiReveal: 🧱 The servants of {walls} at {town} whisper that {ruler} had {name} walled up alive there.
